description: Create the complete LTX23_Director_2_0_MV_Colab.py file implementing the full LTX-2.3 Director 2.0 Music Video pipeline for Google Colab T4
steps: Create /projects/ms/LTX23_Director_2_0_MV_Colab.py with all required components:
1. Imports section: os, sys, gc, json, time, subprocess, shutil, dataclasses, typing, pathlib, traceback, torch, numpy

2. LTX23Config @dataclass with all workflow parameters: model filenames (ltx-2-3-22b-dev-Q4_K_M.gguf, LTX23_video_vae_bf16.safetensors, LTX23_audio_vae_bf16.safetensors, taeltx2_3.safetensors, ltx-2.3-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.1.safetensors), text encoders (gemma_3_12B_it_fp4_mixed.safetensors + ltx-2.3_text_projection_bf16.safetensors type=ltxv), 4 LoRAs with strengths (distilled 0.4, OmniNFT 0.6, transition 0.7, MVCamera 0.9), resolution 1280x720, frame_rate 24, duration 31.5s, total_frames 756, Stage 1 (euler, linear_quadratic, 8 steps, denoise 1.0, cfg 1, guide_strength 0.5), Stage 2 (euler, linear_quadratic, 4 steps, denoise 0.42, cfg 1, guide_strength 1.0), seed 0 fixed, img_compression 18, divisible_by 32, resize_method maintain_aspect_ratio, project_dir /content/LTX23_Project, comfyui_dir /content/ComfyUI, test_mode flag

3. MemoryManager class: track VRAM usage via torch.cuda, get_free_vram(), get_total_vram(), report(), cleanup() with gc.collect + torch.cuda.empty_cache + torch.cuda.ipc_collect, dynamic_chunk_size() returning 8/9/17/25/33 frames based on available memory thresholds, emergency_cleanup() for OOM situations

4. Timeline parsing: TimelineSegment dataclass, parse_timeline() function that extracts 5 image segments with start/length/imageFile and audio segment with trimStart from the workflow JSON timeline_data

5. Pre-flight checks function: verify CUDA available, check GPU memory >= 14GB, verify disk space, verify model files exist in expected paths, verify custom nodes installed (ComfyUI-GGUF, ComfyUI-KJNodes, ComfyUI-LTXVideo, rgthree-comfy, comfyui-videohelpersuite)

6. Environment setup function: install torch, ComfyUI clone, custom nodes clone (ComfyUI-GGUF, ComfyUI-KJNodes, ComfyUI-LTXVideo, rgthree-comfy, comfyui-videohelpersuite), pip installs, apt packages (aria2, ffmpeg)
7. Model download function using aria2c: download all models to correct ComfyUI subdirectories (unet, text_encoders, vae, latent_upscale_models, loras) with proper URLs from HuggingFace
8. Asset download: download reference images (whatdreamscost/1.png through 5.3.png) and audio (whatdreamscost/Late night trap.mp3) to ComfyUI/input/whatdreamscost/
9. import_custom_nodes() function using asyncio pattern from references (init_builtin_extra_nodes + init_external_custom_nodes with nest_asyncio for Colab)
10. get_value_at_index() helper matching reference pattern
11. Checkpoint/resume system: generation_state.json in project_dir tracking completed_chunks, current_chunk_index, seed, config hash; save_state() and load_state() functions

12. ChunkProcessor class implementing LOAD-USE-RELEASE-CLEAN-CHECKPOINT pattern: process_chunk() generates frames for a given chunk range, saves chunk video to disk immediately, releases all tensors, calls memory cleanup, saves checkpoint state

13. Core generation pipeline using NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS + EXECUTE_NORMALIZED pattern: (a) UnetLoaderGGUF load transformer, (b) DualCLIPLoader with gemma + ltx text projection, (c) Power Lora Loader applying 4 LoRAs sequentially via LoraLoaderModelOnly, (d) ModelPreviewOverrideKJ with tiny VAE, (e) LTXDirector node with full timeline_data, global_prompt, frame_rate, resolution config, (f) ConditioningZeroOut for negative, (g) LTXVConditioning wrapping positive+negative with frame_rate

14. Two-stage sampling implementation: Stage 1 - LTXDirectorGuide(guide_strength=0.5) + RandomNoise(seed=0,fixed) + BasicScheduler(linear_quadratic,steps=8,denoise=1.0) + KSamplerSelect(euler) + CFGGuider(cfg=1) + LTXVConcatAVLatent + SamplerCustomAdvanced; then LTXVSeparateAVLatent + LTXDirectorCropGuides(55). Stage 2 - LTXVLatentUpsampler(14) + LTXDirectorGuide(132,guide_strength=1.0) + BasicScheduler(linear_quadratic,steps=4,denoise=0.42) + CFGGuider(cfg=1) + LTXVConcatAVLatent + SamplerCustomAdvanced; then LTXVSeparateAVLatent + LTXDirectorCropGuides(54)
15. Chunked frame generation with OOM detection: try/except RuntimeError for CUDA OOM, retry with smaller chunk size (halve frames), bounded retries (max 3), seed determinism preserved on retry
16. VAE decode: VAEDecode for video latent using video VAE, LTXVAudioVAEDecode for audio using audio VAE
17. Chunk saving: save decoded video frames to /content/LTX23_Project/chunks/chunk_NNN.mp4 using ffmpeg subprocess
18. FFmpeg final assembly: concatenate all chunk videos + overlay audio track, output format h264-mp4 crf=8 pix_fmt=yuv420p at 24fps, use concat demuxer to avoid loading all frames into RAM
19. Dual execution mode: primary mode uses direct Python NODE_CLASS_MAPPINGS execution; fallback mode uses ComfyUI API queue (POST to localhost:8188/prompt with workflow JSON)
20. Test mode: when config.test_mode=True, generate only 8-17 frames for validation, skip full 756-frame generation
21. Performance logging: log time per chunk, VRAM usage per chunk, total generation time
22. Emergency cleanup: atexit handler, signal handlers for graceful shutdown, cleanup temp files on failure

23. main() function orchestrating full flow: parse args, setup environment, download models, preflight checks, init memory manager, parse timeline, determine chunks based on dynamic sizing, process chunks with checkpoint/resume, ffmpeg assembly, display result
24. if __name__ == '__main__' block calling main()

Contains chunked generation with OOM retry logic
Contains FFmpeg final assembly using concat demuxer
Contains dual execution mode (direct + API fallback)
Contains test mode for 8-17 frame validation
File is >2000 lines of complete implementation (not stubs)
